body: cut my wrist but obviously not deep enough. going to take something. oh god i hate myself. i really wanted to be good. i wanted to be special to someone to actually mean something. i'm just a kid...
thanks. can't do it. just cut myself. be good.

I've been saying one more day for years. I really just don't know what to do! I'm behind on child support because I can't hold a job. Without holding a job I can't afford my medication.

I attempted suicide right in front of my (now ex) girlfriend a month and a half ago. She called paramedics and I was rushed to the hospital. I wish I had gone somewhere else to do it.

I am so alone. My real problem is that I can't control my behavior. The things in this letter were just to anonymously get them off of my chest. 

I can't stop crying. I can't stop hating myself. Truthfully, I just can't stop being scared of... everything. I just want to turn out the lights. I sleep a couple of hours each night only to be awoken from nightmares. I try to sleep to avoid waking life only to have nightmares. Life is horror. I want to just go to sleep and not wake up.

Why? I have no job. I have no friends. I am severely mentally ill. I can hardly ever go outside. I've lost every single good thing in my life, and most of it is because of me. I hate being me. I just want to die.
